name: David Okonkwo
psychographics: Results-oriented and disciplined, he treats budgeting like a secondary job to ensure his teen has opportunities he didn't have growing up.
current_solutions: Uses the Flipp app to circular-shop across Walmart, Target, and Aldi. He also grows herbs in a window box to reduce produce costs.
frustration: The Flipp app crashed right as the weekly ad dropped at 6am Sunday, forcing him to drive to three stores manually to compare prices, wasting $15 in gas.
decision_style: Compares unit prices (price per ounce) religiously; often chooses the store brand even if he dislikes the taste, just to hit the budget target.
voice: Calm, methodical, and slightly jargon-heavy when discussing 'unit costs' or 'loss leaders', but relaxed when talking about weekend plans.
